title: Future in the past
note: was going to / would / was about to from past viewpoint · thin shell night/2026-08-05

items.en: I thought it would rain later.
accepts: I thought it would rain later.

items.en: She was going to call, but she forgot.
items.gap: She ____ going to call, but she forgot.
accepts: She was going to call, but she forgot.

items.en: We were about to leave when he arrived.
items.cz: Už jsme skoro odcházeli, když dorazil.
items.gap: We ____ about to leave when he arrived.
accepts: We were about to leave when he arrived.
items.explanation: Imminent past future: was/were about to.

items.en: He said he would help us the next day.
items.cz: Řekl, že nám druhý den pomůže.
items.gap: He said he ____ help us the next day.
accepts: He said he would help us the next day.

items.en: I was going to study medicine.
accepts: I was going to study medicine.

items.en: They knew the meeting would start late.
items.gap: They knew the meeting ____ start late.
accepts: They knew the meeting would start late.

items.en: She was about to speak when someone interrupted.
items.cz: Už chtěla promluvit, když ji někdo přerušil.
items.gap: She ____ about to speak when someone interrupted.
accepts: She was about to speak when someone interrupted.

items.en: We thought they would arrive by noon.
items.cz: Mysleli jsme, že dorazí do poledne.
items.gap: We thought they ____ arrive by noon.
accepts: We thought they would arrive by noon.

items.en: I was going to tell you yesterday.
items.cz: Chtěl jsem ti to říct včera.
items.gap: I ____ going to tell you yesterday.
accepts: I was going to tell you yesterday.

items.en: He promised he would write soon.
accepts: He promised he would write soon.
